g.text: The 1D model is right where this workload sits, and the low-k BEOL is what punishes leaving it
Ansys MAPDL 26.1, 3D steady conduction, 4 mm repeating unit cell, adiabatic lateral faces (a periodic hotspot array).
Total tier power held at the die-average density throughout, so only the concentration changes. Stack is the stated design study.
